name: Yamaha Star Venture / Eluder
engine: 1854 cc air-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Yamaha's modern full-dress tourer. Lots of electronics, and a front brake switch recall on many bikes.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Many 2018-2021 Star Ventures and 2018 Eluders are in recall 20V814 for the front brake switch.
A-002.reason: NHTSA flagged it do-not-ride until fixed. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Front brake switch can fail from silicon oxide buildup, leaving the brake light on or cutting out cruise control.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the front brake switch free.

forums.name: Venture Riders
forums.what: Owner club for Yamaha Venture touring bikes.
